notes:
**CAFFA**: Swedish authorities seized the 96m cargo vessel on **March 6, 2026** off **Trelleborg** (Baltic Sea) for transporting **stolen Ukrainian grain** as part of Russia's shadow fleet. It flew a false Guinean flag and had maritime safety violations. Confiscated in late March following a foreign legal assistance request.

*Sources: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/04/29/sweden-confiscates-false-flagged-russian-shadow-fleet-ship-prosecutors-say), [Splash247](https://splash247.com/sweden-confiscates-bulk-carrier-accused-of-carrying-stolen-ukrainian-grain/), [UNITED24 Media](https://united24media.com/latest-news/swedish-authorities-issue-arrest-warrant-for-russian-commander-of-cargo-vessel-caffa-16683)*

**MARINERA**: US forces seized the oil tanker on **January 7, 2026** in the **North Atlantic** between Iceland and Scotland after a weeks-long pursuit. Formerly Bella 1, it was reflagged to Russia and seized under a federal court warrant for violating US sanctions on Venezuelan oil.

*Sources: [ABC News](https://abcnews.go.com/International/us-seizes-russian-flagged-oil-tanker-north-atlantic/story?id=128976500), [NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/venezuela/us-seize-russia-flagged-oil-tanker-bella1-marinera-venezuela-rcna252738), [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y2v8ngl14o)*

**DEYNA**: French Navy, with British support, seized the shadow fleet tanker on **March 20, 2026** in the Western Mediterranean off Algeria. Sailing from Murmansk to Port Said under a fraudulent Mozambican flag, it carried Russian crude oil. The vessel had undergone 13 identity changes and was sanctioned across six jurisdictions. Escorted to Gulf of Fos for investigation, it was later released after a fine was paid.

*Sources: [Windward](https://windward.ai/knowledge-base/m-t-deyna-seized-what-the-french-navys-mediterranean-interdiction-signals-for-the-shadow-fleet/), [Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/03/20/france-seizes-false-flagged-oil-tanker-coming-from-russia-a92285), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/03/23/8026765/)*

**EAGLE S**: Finnish authorities seized the Cook Islands-flagged tanker on **December 26, 2024** in the **Gulf of Finland** after it damaged five undersea cables (Estlink 2 power cable and four data cables) by dragging its anchor for ~90 km on December 25. Suspected of being part of Russia's shadow fleet, it departed from Ust-Luga with oil products. The crew was detained and the vessel was escorted to Porvoo port.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eagle_S), [Atlantic Council](https://www.atlanticcouncil.org/in-depth-research-reports/the-shadow-fleet-is-undermining-the-maritime-order-more-brazenly-than-ever/), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2024/12/31/nx-s1-5243302/finland-russia-severed-undersea-cable-shadow-fleet)*

**ENIGMA**: Russian frigate Admiral Grigorovich convoyed the Cameroon-registered shadow fleet tanker through the **English Channel** on **April 8, 2025**, shadowed by UK fleet replenishment ship RFA Tideforce. The vessel, transporting Russian crude oil, is sanctioned by the UK, EU, Switzerland, Canada, Australia, and Ukraine.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [War-Sanctions](https://war-sanctions.gur.gov.ua/en/transport/shadow-fleet/767)*

**ETHERA**: Belgian forces seized the oil tanker on **March 1, 2026** in the **North Sea** (Belgium's EEZ) during **Operation Blue Intruder** with French support. Part of Russia's shadow fleet, it flew a false Guinean flag and was on the EU sanctions list. Escorted to **Zeebrugge** port where it remains under judicial seizure with a €10 million bail.

*Sources: [Windward](https://windward.ai/knowledge-base/belgiums-seizure-of-sanctioned-tanker-ethera/), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/belgium-seizes-suspected-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker/a-76174050), [gCaptain](https://gcaptain.com/belgium-seizes-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker-linked-to-iran/)*

**EVENTIN**: German customs seized the Panama-flagged tanker on **March 21, 2025** off **Rügen** (Baltic Sea) after it lost engine power and drifted into German waters. Part of Russia's shadow fleet, it carried ~100,000 tons of sanctioned Russian crude oil. German authorities confiscated both the vessel and its cargo in an unprecedented move.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-seizes-suspected-russian-shadow-fleet-oil-tanker/a-71999181), [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czdlp67rvd1o)*

**GRINCH (now TRANSFORMER)**: French Navy seized the shadow fleet tanker on **January 22, 2026** in the Alboran Sea (Western Mediterranean) between Spain and Morocco. The vessel, sailing under a false Comoros flag from Murmansk, was suspected of transporting Russian oil in violation of sanctions. An Indian captain was arrested. The tanker was released in February 2026 after paying a fine of several million euros.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/02/17/france-releases-suspected-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker-after-fine), [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8xy4dl2xwgo)*

**JIN HUI**: Swedish authorities seized the 182m tanker on **May 3, 2026** at ~14:00 in territorial waters **south of Trelleborg** (Baltic Sea). Suspected of being part of Russia's shadow fleet, it flew a false Syrian flag, had deficient seaworthiness, and appears on EU, UK, and Ukraine sanctions lists.

*Sources: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/05/03/8032944/), [Militarnyi](https://militarnyi.com/en/news/sweden-detains-shadow-fleet-vessel-jin-hui/), [Channel NewsAsia](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/sweden-boards-suspected-shadow-fleet-vessel-6097226)*

**SEA OWL I**: Swedish authorities seized the 228m tanker on **March 12-13, 2026** off **Trelleborg** (Baltic Sea) during Operation Svart kaffe. Suspected of being part of Russia's shadow fleet, it flew false Comoros/Cameroon flags, had forged documents, and is on the EU sanctions list.

*Sources: [UNITED24 Media](https://united24media.com/latest-news/swedish-coast-guard-seizes-suspected-stateless-sea-owl-i-vessel-in-baltic-sea-16818), [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpqwg0yej04o), [AP News](https://apnews.com/article/sweden-sea-owl-captain-detained-russia-shadow-fleet-cca0c94b55a02a416846583dafb8f78d)*

**SEAHORSE**: US destroyer USS Stockdale intercepted the sanctioned shadow fleet tanker on **November 13, 2025** in the Caribbean Sea as it sailed toward Venezuela with naphtha cargo. The vessel, under false Comoros flag and EU/UK sanctions, was forced to change course to Cuba multiple times but eventually reached Venezuelan waters on November 23.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [Maritime Executive](https://maritime-executive.com/article/report-us-destroyer-blocks-sanctioned-shadow-tanker-s-route-to-venezuela), [gCaptain](https://gcaptain.com/russian-tanker-idle-near-venezuela-after-us-ship-enters-path/)*

**SELVA**: Russian Navy escorted the shadow fleet tanker on **June 16, 2026** through the English Channel as part of the first military convoy for sanctioned vessels. The tanker was under UK and EU sanctions.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/alarm-raised-russia-shadow-fleet-hybrid-warfare-threat-nato-11981779)*

**SIERRA**: Russian Navy escorted the shadow fleet tanker on **June 16, 2026** through the English Channel as part of the first military convoy for sanctioned vessels. The tanker was under UK and EU sanctions.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/alarm-raised-russia-shadow-fleet-hybrid-warfare-threat-nato-11981779)*

**SUN**: Polish authorities scared off the Antigua and Barbuda-flagged shadow fleet tanker on **May 21, 2026** after it was spotted sailing around an undersea 600-megawatt power line linking Sweden and Poland in the Baltic Sea. The 159,000 dwt crude oil tanker was monitored and the area was later swept by the Polish research ship ORP Heweliusz.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [Maritime Executive](https://maritime-executive.com/article/polish-military-responds-to-shadow-fleet-tanker-acting-suspiciously)*

**UNIVERSAL**: Russian frigate Admiral Grigorovich convoyed the Russian-flagged shadow fleet tanker through the **English Channel** on **April 8, 2025**, shadowed by UK's RFA Tideforce. The vessel, previously outlawed in British waters and sanctioned by OFAC, the EU, and the UK, was carrying military-relevant cargo for Russia's armed forces. It had fled Russian ports hit by Ukrainian drone strikes and picked up its escort in the Baltic Sea on April 2.

*Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet), [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn8pvgw802no), [Maritime Executive](https://maritime-executive.com/article/russia-s-shadow-fleet-thumbs-its-nose-at-the-royal-navy)*

**VERONICA III**: US forces boarded and seized the Panama-flagged shadow fleet tanker on **February 14-15, 2026** in the Indian Ocean after tracking it from the Caribbean. The vessel, sanctioned since December 2024, had departed Venezuela on January 3 with ~1.9 million barrels of crude and fuel oil. It previously transported Iranian oil for the National Iranian Oil Company and China Concord Petroleum Company.

*Sources: [gCaptain](https://gcaptain.com/u-s-boards-shadow-fleet-tanker-veronica-iii-in-indian-ocean), [UNITED24 Media](https://united24media.com/latest-news/us-navy-intercepts-iran-shadow-fleet-sanctions-evading-tanker-veronica-iii-15916), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_shadow_fleet)*
